## Homeowner Chooses Byrna for Less-Lethal Home Defense


Home protection is about more than simply[having a defensive tool available.](https://byrna.com/collections/byrna-non-lethal-guns) For many homeowners, the goal is to feel prepared to respond to a potential threat while having options that fit the situation. For one homeowner, that meant adding a Byrna launcher to an existing home defense plan.


Already owning firearms, the homeowner recognized that a firearm may not always be the preferred response to an unwanted person entering the home. The possibility of using deadly force can carry significant consequences, making it important to consider other self-defense options when appropriate.


After learning about Byrna, the homeowner began researching the platform and its less-lethal approach. The result was an added layer of protection designed to provide an alternative to a firearm during a potentially dangerous situation.


### An Additional Option for Home Protection


A Byrna launcher is designed to give homeowners the ability to respond from a distance without relying exclusively on a firearm. Depending on the launcher and ammunition selected, Byrna offers different projectile options for personal protection and training.


For someone who works from home, having an accessible self-defense option can also provide additional peace of mind throughout the day. Rather than being limited to a single response, a broader home defense strategy can include awareness, preparation, secure storage, training, and multiple force options.


The homeowner's motivation was straightforward: discourage a potential intruder from continuing the encounter without necessarily resorting to deadly force. A visible defensive response may also communicate that the residence is occupied and that the homeowner is prepared to protect the property and its occupants.


### Preparedness Starts With Having Options


No home defense plan can predict exactly how an emergency will unfold. However, preparing in advance can help homeowners make more informed decisions under pressure.


For those looking for a less-lethal self-defense option, Byrna provides an alternative worth researching. Combined with responsible storage, regular training, and a clear plan for contacting emergency services and getting to safety, having multiple options can be an important part of being prepared to defend.
